name: FarmingLPToken spot-quote share inflation
summary: FarmingLPToken minted shares from manipulable router spot quotes. After inflating the quoted SUSHI value of a small LP deposit, the attacker used the resulting shares to withdraw the vault's pre-existing USDC/WETH LP tokens and transferred surplus shares away before the withdrawal burn.
notes: This EIP-1167 clone deployment immutably selected the defect-bearing FarmingLPToken implementation.

The exploited vault transferred 0.000020144470251713 SushiSwap USDC/WETH LP tokens, which the attack contract burned in the same transaction for exactly 1,601.512305 USDC and 0.786674387891306409 WETH.
